document_overview.name: High-Performance Local Chatbot Repository
document_overview.purpose: Provide an offline, privacy‑preserving chatbot implementation that runs large language models efficiently on consumer‑grade NVIDIA GPUs using 4‑bit quantization.
document_overview.description: The document describes a repository that enables local LLM inference with 4‑bit quantization, outlines its key features such as offline operation, optimized performance on NVIDIA hardware, persistent chat history, and a minimalist codebase, and lists the hardware and software prerequisites required to run it.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.description: Brief overview of the repository’s goal to deliver a private, responsive AI chatbot that runs locally without external cloud APIs.

sections.heading: Key Features
sections.description: Enumerates the main capabilities of the repository, including offline inference, NVIDIA‑optimized performance, chat history persistence, and a lightweight design.

sections.heading: Prerequisites
sections.description: Specifies the required hardware and software environment needed to run the repository.

entities.name: 4-bit Quantization
entities.description: A model compression method that reduces weight precision to 4 bits, enabling efficient inference on limited GPU memory.
